steps.npc: Hello young [man/lady/one]!  Come to visit old Grandpa Jack? I can tell ye stories for sure. I used to be the best fisherman these parts have seen!
Well, when I were a young man we used to take fishing trips over to Catherby; The fishing over there - now that was something!
Anyway, we decided to do a bit of fishing with our nets, I wasn't having the best of days turning up nothing but old boots and bits of seaweed. Then my net suddenly got really heavy!
To my amazement I'd caught this little chest thing!
Even more amazing was when I opened it it contained a diamond the size of a radish! That's the best catch I've ever had!

options.text: Sorry, I don't have time now.

steps.player: Sorry, I don't have time now.

steps.npc: Young people - always in such a rush.

options.text: Can I buy one of your fishing rods?

steps.player: Can I buy one of your fishing rods?

steps.text: If the player has a fishing rod in their inventory:

steps.npc: But young man, you have your own. I'll not sell you mine when you already have one!
Of course you can young man. Let's see now...I think 5 gold is a fair price for a rod which has won the Fishing contest before eh?

steps.text: If the player has insufficient coins:

steps.player: I don't have enough money for that, I'll go get some and come back.

steps.npc: Right you are. I'll be here.

options.text: Very fair, I'll buy that rod!

steps.player: Very fair, I'll buy that rod!

steps.text: If the player has insufficient inventory space:

steps.player: Only problem is, I don't have any space to carry one right now. Let me get back to you on that.

steps.npc: Right you are. I'll be here.

steps.text: You hand over the money and receive a fishing rod.

options.text: That's too rich for me, I'll go to Catherby.

steps.player: That's too rich for me, I'll go to Catherby.

steps.npc: If you're sure.... passing up an opportunity of a lifetime you are.

options.text: I've forgotten how to fish, can you remind me?

steps.player: I've forgotten how to fish, can you remind me?

steps.npc: Of course! Let me see now...You'll need a rod and bait. You can fish with a net too, but not in the competition.

steps.player: Ok... I think I can get those at Catherby.
